name: Oyako Rankan
source:
After a fire destroyed their village and killed their parents, Mamoru and his older sister, Kotone, were adopted into the wealthy Kamishiro household. Years later, Mamoru now serves as the household's butler. As a matter of fact, however, the Kamishiro family harbors a dark secret: its wealth and influence stem from a ritualistic orgy known as the "Feast." Kamishiro women are renowned for their passion, fertility, and unrivaled offspring quality. During the Feast, influential men from around the world pay hands动 to fertilize these peerless wombs.

Meanwhile, the bedridden Kamishiro head Ikki faces exile by the end of the month if he cannot impregnate his lovely wife, Saya, with the next heir. Ikki calls for a new feast with Kotone as the offering in response to pressure from his clients and the scheming lieutenant Shinohara. 

With clients swarming to the manor like locusts, Mamoru is thrown into a nightmare. Can he protect Kotone, Saya, and his younger stepsister Ririko from the Feast until the end of the month?

[Edited from [url=http://sanahtlig.blogspot.com/2015/10/oyako-rankan-english-prologue-patch-preview.html]Sanahtlig's Corner[/url]]
translation:
一场大火摧毁了他们的村庄并夺走了父母的生命后，守和姐姐琴音被富裕的神城家收养。多年后，守如今担任这个家族的管家。然而事实上，神城家族隐藏着一个黑暗的秘密：家族的财富和影响力来源于一场名为“盛宴”的仪式性淫乱。神城家的女性以热情、高生育力和无与伦比的后代质量而闻名。在盛宴期间，来自世界各地的有权有势的男人们花费巨资来让这些无与伦比的子宫受孕。

与此同时，卧病在床的神城家家主一辉面临月底被流放的命运，如果他不能让可爱的妻子沙夜怀上继承人的话。在客户和阴谋家副手筱原的施压下，一辉以琴音为祭品召开了新的盛宴。

客户们如蝗虫般涌向宅邸，守陷入了噩梦。他能在月底之前保护琴音、沙夜和年幼的继妹莉莉子免受盛宴的侵害吗？
